frequency_v2_q0301.prompt: After a bad day, you come home. Your partner is there and wants to spend time with you. How do you spend the evening?

options.frequency_v2_q0301_a: I spend most of it on my own and join them when I'm ready.
options.frequency_v2_q0301_b: I stay in the same space but mostly focus on my own thing.
options.frequency_v2_q0301_c: I take a little alone time, then spend most of the evening together.
options.frequency_v2_q0301_d: I'd rather be together start to finish than alone that evening.

frequency_v2_q0302.prompt: Someone new you've been seeing keeps asking "how was your day?" You tend to share less in those daily check-ins.

options.frequency_v2_q0302_c: I say "I usually keep it brief."
options.frequency_v2_q0302_d: If the pace doesn't match, I text less often.

frequency_v2_q0303.prompt: While living together, you have different standards about cleanliness.

options.frequency_v2_q0303_a: I try to find a middle ground.
options.frequency_v2_q0303_b: I keep my own space to my own standard.
options.frequency_v2_q0303_d: We talk it through openly and split tasks.

frequency_v2_q0304.prompt: Your partner showed up as a surprise visit. You wanted alone time right then.

options.frequency_v2_q0304_b: I say "A heads-up would have been nice."
options.frequency_v2_q0304_c: I spend a little time together, then say I need alone time.
options.frequency_v2_q0304_d: I politely suggest rescheduling at the door.

frequency_v2_q0305.prompt: You've had a few dates with someone new. They bring small gifts every time.

options.frequency_v2_q0305_b: I thank them and don't reciprocate for now.
options.frequency_v2_q0305_c: I say "You don't need to do that."
options.frequency_v2_q0305_d: If things speed up, I slow down the gift exchange.

frequency_v2_q0306.prompt: In an argument, your partner isn't raising their voice but sounds very cold.

options.frequency_v2_q0306_a: I say "This is hard to talk through like this."
options.frequency_v2_q0306_c: I try to open up the emotional side.
options.frequency_v2_q0306_d: I table it and change the setting.

frequency_v2_q0307.prompt: Your partner is juggling several social plans at once and keeps trying to include you.

options.frequency_v2_q0307_c: I say "This pace isn't really for me."

frequency_v2_q0308.prompt: You're getting to know someone new. They use early "you make me feel special" type lines.

options.frequency_v2_q0308_a: I respond in a similar way.
options.frequency_v2_q0308_b: I gently keep my own pace.
options.frequency_v2_q0308_d: If it gets too intense, I pull back.

frequency_v2_q0309.prompt: You're taking a trip together. They want every detail planned; you prefer deciding on the road.

options.frequency_v2_q0309_a: I go along with their plan.
options.frequency_v2_q0309_b: I say "Let's leave some room to be flexible."
options.frequency_v2_q0309_d: I say "You plan it, I'll follow along."

frequency_v2_q0310.prompt: Your partner took offense at a joke you had with a friend.

options.frequency_v2_q0310_c: I talk it through privately later.
options.frequency_v2_q0310_d: I let it pass without engaging.

frequency_v2_q0311.prompt: After a long day, your partner says "I need to talk." You're tired too.

options.frequency_v2_q0311_c: I say "Can we keep it short?"
options.frequency_v2_q0311_d: I mention that I'm tired too.

frequency_v2_q0312.prompt: You've been seeing someone new for a few weeks. You haven't joined a shared friend group yet.

options.frequency_v2_q0312_b: If they suggest it, I'll join.
options.frequency_v2_q0312_d: I don't rush into a shared social circle.

frequency_v2_q0313.prompt: Your partner wants to open up about something personal (money, family, health), but you don't feel that close yet.

options.frequency_v2_q0313_b: I listen but share little about myself.
options.frequency_v2_q0313_c: I say "We'll talk when I'm ready."
options.frequency_v2_q0313_d: I gently steer the topic elsewhere.

frequency_v2_q0314.prompt: One evening at home, your partner keeps asking "what should we do?" You don't want to suggest anything.

options.frequency_v2_q0314_d: I go back to my own thing.

frequency_v2_q0315.prompt: Your partner reacted less than you expected to a win of yours (work or personal).

options.frequency_v2_q0315_b: I say "I was hoping you'd be a little more excited."
options.frequency_v2_q0315_d: I bring it up again later.

frequency_v2_q0316.prompt: You're getting to know someone new. They want to stay longer every date.

options.frequency_v2_q0316_c: I say "Let's keep it a bit shorter."
options.frequency_v2_q0316_d: If the pace picks up, I see them less often.

frequency_v2_q0317.prompt: After an argument, your partner said "I need to think" and left. What do you do?

options.frequency_v2_q0317_a: I send a message soon saying I want to talk and repair things when they're ready.
options.frequency_v2_q0317_b: I give a little time and reopen the conversation the same day.
options.frequency_v2_q0317_c: I give them space that day and bring it up calmly the next day.
options.frequency_v2_q0317_d: If they don't reopen it, neither do I.

frequency_v2_q0318.prompt: Your partner can't decide between staying in and going out and wants both.

frequency_v2_q0319.prompt: While talking to someone new, they share very open, detailed personal stories.

options.frequency_v2_q0319_b: I listen and share only a little about myself.
options.frequency_v2_q0319_d: I try to keep things lighter.

frequency_v2_q0320.prompt: You went to an event together. Your partner keeps introducing you to their friends.

options.frequency_v2_q0320_b: I feel a bit overwhelmed but keep going.
options.frequency_v2_q0320_c: I say "Let's introduce me a little less."
options.frequency_v2_q0320_d: I step aside after a while.

frequency_v2_q0321.prompt: Your partner said they find a habit of yours cute (staying up late, leaving things messy, thinking out loud). It bothers you.

options.frequency_v2_q0321_b: I accept it as it is.
options.frequency_v2_q0321_c: I say "I think it's actually a problem."

frequency_v2_q0322.prompt: After a long separation, you're back together. Your partner wants to jump straight back to old closeness.

options.frequency_v2_q0322_c: I say "I need a little time."
options.frequency_v2_q0322_d: I clearly keep my own pace.

frequency_v2_q0323.prompt: You had a plan. Your partner is talking vaguely: "maybe we'll do something else."

options.frequency_v2_q0323_c: I prepare my own backup plan.

frequency_v2_q0324.prompt: Your partner gently raised a criticism about you (communication style, time management).

options.frequency_v2_q0324_a: I try to fix it right away.
options.frequency_v2_q0324_c: I accept it but don't change.
options.frequency_v2_q0324_d: I point out something of theirs in return.

frequency_v2_q0325.prompt: After a few dates, someone new says "I'm looking for something serious." You're not that clear yet.

options.frequency_v2_q0325_c: I say "Let's see where time takes us."
options.frequency_v2_q0325_d: If things speed up, I step back.

frequency_v2_q0326.prompt: While living together, your partner often asks "what should we eat?" and waits for you to decide.

frequency_v2_q0327.prompt: Your partner is asking curious questions about an ex of yours.

options.frequency_v2_q0327_d: I say "Should we talk about your ex too?"

frequency_v2_q0328.prompt: One evening, your partner said "I want to be alone."

options.frequency_v2_q0328_c: A quick "okay" and back to my own thing.
options.frequency_v2_q0328_d: I offer to stay nearby quietly.

frequency_v2_q0329.prompt: You're getting to know someone new. They plan dates carefully; you prefer spontaneity.

options.frequency_v2_q0329_d: I try to find a middle ground.

frequency_v2_q0330.prompt: Your partner expressed a positive feeling about you (missing you, feeling attached) for the first time.

options.frequency_v2_q0330_b: I thank them and take it in.
options.frequency_v2_q0330_d: I say "I need a little time."

frequency_v2_q0331.prompt: In an argument, your partner thinks they're right and won't back down.

options.frequency_v2_q0331_d: I ask more questions to understand.

frequency_v2_q0332.prompt: Your partner invited you to a family occasion. You already had another commitment that day.

options.frequency_v2_q0332_a: I break my plan and go.
options.frequency_v2_q0332_c: I drop by briefly and leave.

frequency_v2_q0333.prompt: While texting someone new, they write long messages; you prefer short and to the point.

options.frequency_v2_q0333_c: I say "I tend to write shorter messages."
options.frequency_v2_q0333_d: If the pace doesn't match, I text less.

frequency_v2_q0334.prompt: Your partner clearly said they don't want to join one of your hobbies.

options.frequency_v2_q0334_a: I get it—we do it separately.
options.frequency_v2_q0334_b: I ask them to try it once.
options.frequency_v2_q0334_c: I skip some of their things too.
options.frequency_v2_q0334_d: We talk about whether this difference will become a problem.

frequency_v2_q0335.prompt: Picking a movie together, you keep disagreeing on the same genre.

frequency_v2_q0336.prompt: Your partner is hinting at something about you rather than saying it directly.

options.frequency_v2_q0336_b: I pick up on it and adjust.
options.frequency_v2_q0336_c: I wait for them to be clear.

frequency_v2_q0337.prompt: After a long silence, your partner texted or called again.

options.frequency_v2_q0337_d: I'm glad and ramp up the pace.

frequency_v2_q0338.prompt: Your partner is questioning a decision of yours (job, move, personal change).

frequency_v2_q0339.prompt: After a few dates, someone new is moving physical contact faster.

options.frequency_v2_q0339_d: If the pace doesn't fit, I pull back.

frequency_v2_q0340.prompt: Your partner keeps bringing up a habit of yours (phone use, running late).

options.frequency_v2_q0340_b: I say "That's just how I am."
options.frequency_v2_q0340_c: I point out something of theirs too.
options.frequency_v2_q0340_d: I ask them to stop bringing it up.

frequency_v2_q0341.prompt: Your partner shared a secret about you and said "don't tell anyone."

options.frequency_v2_q0341_b: I say "That feels like a lot."
options.frequency_v2_q0341_c: I share a similar secret of my own.
options.frequency_v2_q0341_d: I don't open the topic further.

frequency_v2_q0342.prompt: You had plans. Your partner canceled last minute: "I'm just not feeling it."

options.frequency_v2_q0342_a: I get it—we'll pick another day.
options.frequency_v2_q0342_c: I say "Let's be clearer next time."
options.frequency_v2_q0342_d: I switch to my own backup plan.

frequency_v2_q0343.prompt: When your partner saw a win or moment of happiness of yours, they reacted less than you expected.

options.frequency_v2_q0343_b: I say "I was hoping you'd be a little more excited."
options.frequency_v2_q0343_d: I bring it up again later.

frequency_v2_q0344.prompt: You went to a nice restaurant. Their order came out completely wrong, but they said "It's fine, I'll eat it" and stayed quiet.

options.frequency_v2_q0344_a: I call the waiter and politely ask for a replacement.
options.frequency_v2_q0344_b: I ask "Are you sure? We can change it" a few times but don't push if they don't want to.
options.frequency_v2_q0344_c: I don't intervene—it's their boundary, and they should do what feels comfortable.
options.frequency_v2_q0344_d: On the way out I say "Next time let's say something—brushing it off is hard for me."

frequency_v2_q0345.prompt: Six months in, your partner asked "Should we share our locations on our phones all the time?" for safety and practicality.

options.frequency_v2_q0345_a: Great idea—knowing where we are during the day puts me at ease and makes me feel safe.
options.frequency_v2_q0345_b: I'd suggest sharing only when going somewhere late at night or on long trips.
options.frequency_v2_q0345_c: I find it suffocating. Even for safety, the idea of being trackable all the time feels wrong to me.
options.frequency_v2_q0345_d: It doesn't matter to me—if they want to share, I'll turn it on; I won't really check the map anyway.

frequency_v2_q0346.prompt: On vacation in an unfamiliar city, your partner took navigation but took you completely the wrong way and got you lost.

options.frequency_v2_q0346_a: I snap "Why weren't you paying attention?" and take over to find the right route.
options.frequency_v2_q0346_b: I say "Great—we discovered a street we wouldn't have seen" and turn it into an adventure.
options.frequency_v2_q0346_c: I quietly open the map on my phone and give small nudges so they find the right way without making it obvious.
options.frequency_v2_q0346_d: I suggest sitting at a café, resting, and finding the route once we've calmed down.

frequency_v2_q0347.prompt: You're ready for your third date. An hour before, they text: "A family emergency came up—I have to cancel."

options.frequency_v2_q0347_a: I say no worries and make other plans on my own or with friends.
options.frequency_v2_q0347_b: I say I understand; the next day I ask "What happened yesterday—is everything okay now?"
options.frequency_v2_q0347_c: I ask "Is there anything I can do?" and stay in a supportive, ready mode.
options.frequency_v2_q0347_d: I wait for them to set a new date to make it up—I leave the initiative entirely to them.

frequency_v2_q0348.prompt: While living together, your partner lent a large sum from their savings to a close friend without consulting you.

options.frequency_v2_q0348_a: It's their money, none of my business—I respect their decision.
options.frequency_v2_q0348_b: Even though it's their money, I'd be hurt they didn't tell me beforehand since we share a life.
options.frequency_v2_q0348_c: I'd question whether the borrower can pay it back and how this affects our budget.
options.frequency_v2_q0348_d: I say nothing at the time, but if the money doesn't come back I make it a major issue.

frequency_v2_q0349.prompt: You're assembling a complicated piece of furniture together (e.g., a large wardrobe).

options.frequency_v2_q0349_a: I grab the manual, lay out all the pieces, and walk them through it step by step.
options.frequency_v2_q0349_b: I prefer figuring it out by trial and error—building it while chatting and having fun, barely looking at the manual.
options.frequency_v2_q0349_c: I hold whatever they tell me to hold or tighten—leaving them in charge of the project puts me at ease.
options.frequency_v2_q0349_d: I'd suggest hiring a pro, or if they're really into it, letting them assemble it alone while I just watch.

frequency_v2_q0350.prompt: By nature, your partner is very warm, playful, and touchy with everyone (waitstaff, the opposite sex, coworkers).

options.frequency_v2_q0350_a: I like their energetic, affectionate extroversion—it doesn't bother me at all.
options.frequency_v2_q0350_b: I'm quietly unsettled that the special boundary between us and outsiders isn't clearer.
options.frequency_v2_q0350_c: In the moment I try to gently rein them in and keep the focus on us.
options.frequency_v2_q0350_d: While they socialize, I mingle with other people in a similar way in my own space.
